title: Natural History
cn: 第 8 集 · 自然历史
novel: The gang attended a [[black-tie|black-tie]] fundraiser at the Natural History Museum. Everyone dressed in [[elegant|elegant]] gowns and suits. Ted was looking forward to a [[sophisticated|sophisticate]] evening, but things quickly became [[complicated|complicate]]. He ran into Zoey at the event and was [[surprised|surprise]] to learn that she was married. Her husband was a wealthy man known as The Captain, famous for his [[collection|collection]] of rare paintings and his [[eccentric|eccentric]] personality. Ted felt [[uncomfortable|uncomfortable]] because he had been developing feelings for Zoey without knowing she had a husband. The Captain was friendly but [[intimidating|intimidate]]. He shook Ted's hand with a grip that was a little too firm and told him about his [[passion|passion]] for hunting and art. Meanwhile, Barney and Robin explored the museum exhibits. Barney tried to [[impress|impress]] Robin with facts about dinosaurs, but most of what he said was [[inaccurate|inaccurate]]. Robin laughed and corrected him, and for a moment they seemed close again. Marshall and Lily wandered through the [[magnificent|magnificent]] halls, marveling at the giant dinosaur skeletons and the [[stunning|stunning]] gemstone displays. Ted eventually had a private conversation with Zoey. She told him that her marriage was [[strained|strain]] and that she felt [[trapped|trap]] in her life. Ted listened carefully but kept his distance. He knew that getting involved with a married woman would be a [[mistake|mistake]]. The evening ended with the gang standing under the giant blue whale model, looking up in [[awe|awe]]. It had been a night of [[revelation|revelation]], and Ted realized that his feelings for Zoey were more [[dangerous|dangerous]] than he had thought.

sophisticate.en: to make something more refined or complex

complicate.en: to make something harder to understand

surprise.en: to cause someone to feel amazed

collection.en: a group of things gathered together

eccentric.en: behaving in an unusual or odd way

uncomfortable.en: not feeling relaxed or at ease

intimidate.en: to make someone feel afraid or nervous

passion.en: a very strong feeling of love or interest

strain.en: to put pressure on a relationship

trap.en: to keep someone in a place they cannot leave

mistake.en: something you do that is not correct

awe.en: a feeling of great respect and wonder

revelation.en: a surprising thing that is revealed

dangerous.en: likely to cause harm or injury
